An explicit 12-step witness is checked by both; lower bounds follow from symmetric differences. No infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Q4 is the natural first degree-four nonplanar hypercube in a classical cycle-breaking deletion problem. The complete sharp spare-capacity threshold is 2, with a nontrivial 936-to-one component collapse, and the 4-versus-12 distance split reflects the two bipartition classes. These are natural exact invariants of feasible-state mobility in the original model, not a parameter renaming or a narrow arbitrary slice. They offer a reproducible benchmark for feedback-set reconfiguration beyond the subcubic positive theorems.
